_note: Who has unlocked what in Vyneo. Names are Jellyfin user names (not case sensitive). supporters: a gift of 5 dollars or more (the star, colour themes and fonts). pro: 10 dollars or more (Server admin). developers: the people who build Vyneo. A plain name counts only on the developer's own server (homeServerId); write Name@serverId for anyone on another server. Vyneo reads this file when it starts and keeps a copy for offline use.
